newsitem.title: CHINA: TABLE TENNIS-CAI NAMED AS CHINA'S NEW HEAD COACH.
newsitem.headline: TABLE TENNIS-CAI NAMED AS CHINA'S NEW HEAD COACH.

text.p: Cai Zhenhua, 36, coach of China men's table tennis team since 1991, has been appointed the country's head coach. His deputy will be Lu Yuanshen, coach of the women's team since 1995.
Former head coach Xu Shaofa went abroad in 1991 and had not been replaced until now.
China is pre-eminent in the sport and virtually swept the board at the recent world championships in England, taking all the titles except the men's singles which went to Jan-Ove Waldner of Sweden.
